resolvedQuestions: How can dispatchToolCall be made transport-neutral and shared by MCP and CLI while keeping argument errors as CLI results?
What CLI interface, JSON output, preview-file behavior, cache lifetime, and shared data directory satisfy direct terminal use?
How should the plugin and standalone package expose the CLI while preserving dist-relative assets?
How should a batch receive confirmed output names and one selected export location in both Project and skill flows?
Should image_convert support a maximum byte target and should the server guard unconfirmed names?

keyFindings.text: The CLI can consume ALL_TOOLS, the same 40-entry registry passed to registerTools.
dispatchToolCall has reusable schema, placement, and handler behavior, but currently turns validation errors into McpError.
CLI tool arguments must not flow into loadConfig because bare argv tokens become allowed roots.
A separate entry avoids src/index.ts self-running, while signal cancellation must settle children before temp cleanup.
keyFindings.source: AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/src/index.ts:94-126, AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/src/core/process-runner.ts:360-479,687-702

keyFindings.text: Zod v4 exposes toJSONSchema, and listedInputSchema provides the exact caller-facing fields for describe.
keyFindings.source: AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/src/server/tool-registry.ts:91-99, AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/node_modules/zod/v4/classic/schemas.d.ts:7-18

keyFindings.text: Probe previews are base64 MCP image blocks outside structuredContent, so the CLI needs a file adapter.
Capability and binary resolver caches are in-memory only, while dataDir already identifies shared setup installs.
keyFindings.source: AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/src/core/capabilities.ts:163,348-386, AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/src/core/ffmpeg-resolver.ts:446-485

keyFindings.text: MEDIA_EDITOR_DATA_DIR is read by config, setup installs under it, and health reports the configured data folder.
keyFindings.source: AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/src/core/config.ts:87-103,410-451, AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/src/tools/media/setup-ffmpeg.ts:433-475, AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/src/tools/media/health.ts:176-205

keyFindings.text: Current plugin metadata registers MCP and must be changed while retaining Desktop's separate MCP manifest.
keyFindings.source: AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/claude-plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json:10-22, AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/claude-plugin/server/manifest.json:23-35

keyFindings.text: Claude Code expands CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT in plugin skill Markdown, but does not export it to Bash processes.
The CLI package must preserve dist, package metadata, assets, and platform native dependencies for package and font resolution.
keyFindings.source: AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/scripts/build-bundle.ts:68-76, AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/src/core/font-path.ts:41-60

keyFindings.text: The package currently exposes only the MCP server executable and guides do not document CLI installation.
keyFindings.source: AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/package.json:8-22, AI Systems/Media Editor/INSTALL-GUIDE.md:90-118

keyFindings.text: The skill must route covered handlers through CLI then ffmpeg then advice, while the Project stays MCP then advice.
keyFindings.source: AI Systems/Media Editor/sk-media-editor/SKILL.md:73-103, AI Systems/Media Editor/claude project/Custom Instructions.md:157,192-196

keyFindings.text: A skill-only cli.md can hold invocation while tools, setup, and interactive-intelligence stay paired with the Project.
keyFindings.source: AI Systems/Media Editor/SYNC.md:8-13, AI Systems/z - Claude Project Sync Loop/systems.py:1252-1265

keyFindings.text: The deterministic route oracle and differential gate currently lack a surface or backend argument.
Current route phrase counts encode one tools then ffmpeg route and cannot prove the new split without surface-specific assertions.
The twin comparator currently compares only verdict equality although its documentation claims to compare route substance.
SRO-001 assumes the Claude Code plugin registers MCP, while PRO-001 correctly tests Desktop MCP.
The Sync Loop declares seven pairs and keeps router-contract.md out of the Project mirror list.
keyFindings.source: AI Systems/z - Claude Project Sync Loop/systems.py:1252-1275

keyFindings.text: The Project gate is ambiguity-triggered and does not require one confirmation question before every first writing call.
image_convert accepts one input and the writer allocates one destination per call, so separate inputs cannot share one fresh folder.
keyFindings.source: AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/src/tools/image/convert.ts:100-125, AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/src/tools/image/sharp-output.ts:492-512

keyFindings.text: image_convert has a quality control but no strict maximum byte argument.
The current tool argument boundary has no trusted field proving the user confirmed a proposed name.
The current naming scenario tests one screenshot and one output and does not cover a two-or-more-input confirmation gate.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Make paired setup.md surface-exclusive on each side
ruledOutDirections.reason: That would break a currently byte-identical declared setup mirror
ruledOutDirections.evidence: AI Systems/Media Editor/SYNC.md:8-13, AI Systems/z - Claude Project Sync Loop/systems.py:1259-1261

ruledOutDirections.approach: Use one global route order for skill and Project
ruledOutDirections.reason: The Project cannot run terminal ffmpeg and the skill route is CLI-first
ruledOutDirections.evidence: AI Systems/Media Editor/claude project/Custom Instructions.md:157,192-196, AI Systems/Media Editor/sk-media-editor/SKILL.md:77,101

ruledOutDirections.approach: Keep MCP as the connected Claude Code plugin route
ruledOutDirections.reason: Conflicts with the fixed plugin distribution decision and leaves SRO-001 testing the wrong runtime

ruledOutDirections.approach: Treat equal twin verdicts as route equivalence
ruledOutDirections.reason: The comparator currently inspects only the result verdict

ruledOutDirections.approach: Use input-derived names when fileName is omitted for a batch
ruledOutDirections.reason: That default makes the missing name decision a successful write

ruledOutDirections.approach: Set subfolder true on separate calls to reuse one numbered folder
ruledOutDirections.reason: Each call allocates a new numbered folder
ruledOutDirections.evidence: AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/src/core/output-folder.ts:301-341, AI Systems/Media Editor/mcp server/src/tools/image/sharp-output.ts:492-512

ruledOutDirections.approach: Trust a model supplied confirmed boolean
ruledOutDirections.reason: Tool arguments do not carry a trusted user approval event

ruledOutDirections.approach: Treat quality as a strict byte cap
ruledOutDirections.reason: The image_convert schema exposes quality but has no maxBytes field

ruledOutDirections.approach: Silently resize an image until it satisfies maxBytes
ruledOutDirections.reason: This changes dimensions without user approval
